candidate_id.description: Stable detector candidate identifier, usually image-number plus candidate index.

image_id.description: Cassini ISS image ID, for example N1357029177.

x.description: Detector candidate x coordinate in image pixels.

y.description: Detector candidate y coordinate in image pixels.

candidate_score.description: Review-priority score from the detector, not a calibrated probability.

jupiter_latitude.description: Jupiter latitude from geometry/backplanes when available. Blank/null means not computed yet.

jupiter_longitude.description: Jupiter longitude from geometry/backplanes when available. Blank/null means not computed yet.

geometry_status.description: Geometry readiness state, for example pending-backplane, computed, or unavailable.

reviewer_label.description: Public review-page label; mirrors label/human_label for Google Sheets rows.

label.description: Human review label. A possible-lightning label is still not a confirmed discovery.

confidence.description: Reviewer confidence in the label, not detector probability.

notes.description: Short reason for the label, including visual or temporal evidence.

review_stage.description: Where this label sits in the human-review process.

needs_second_review.description: True when the candidate should be checked by another reviewer before use in training or claims.
